review.notes: AegeanWorks cube motif branding for CardMon approved
Baseline overview dashboard layout, navigation, and KPI widgets verified clean and responsive
Aesthetic, functional, and minimalist refinement: PDF button harmonized, no KPI label truncation, clean executive cashflow metric cards, zero visual clutter
Vision review: Clean, minimalistic dark fintech UI with perfect typography, zero label truncation, unified view summary banners, and high visual contrast compliant with G-001 and G-003.

BEFORE baseline at 09a1fc5: clean dark fintech dashboard, 1440x900. Sidebar, topbar, welcome hero, seven KPI widgets and cashflow widget all aligned with no clipping or label truncation. Color mismatch visible: Available-limit value bright emerald-400, Ek Hesap value bright cyan-400, Nearest-due pink-400, while their card accents use deeper token shades; cashflow total also bright emerald-400.

AFTER at 61c42db: pixel-comparison with the before capture shows identical layout, spacing, typography, badges and KPI geometry - no clipping, truncation or contrast regressions. Intended changes visible: Available-limit value now deeper token emerald matching its card border; Ek Hesap value deeper cyan; Nearest-due icon and value now consistent rose instead of two pink shades; sidebar available-limit green matches the KPI. Health pill stays blue (demo state 'good', so the excellent-style change is not visible). Minor residual: cashflow 'Kalan Net Serbest Nakit' total is still bright emerald-400 from a dynamic inline style in js/views.js, so two close greens coexist on the dashboard; recommend unifying it to var(--accent-emerald) in a future pass. Overall cleaner internal color cohesion, G-001/G-003 satisfied.

BEFORE at 08800b4: cashflow widget total 'Kalan Net Serbest Nakit' 75.000₺ uses bright emerald-400 (#34d399), visibly lighter than the token-emerald KPI values and sidebar footer; metric values/dots use mismatched Tailwind shades (amber-400 value vs amber-500 dot, cyan-400 vs cyan-700, purple-300 vs purple-600), and the widget title is cyan-400. Layout, spacing, typography clean; no truncation or clipping. This is the residual issue flagged in the previous vision review.

AFTER at 1d11831: side-by-side with the 2026-11-19 baseline, the cashflow total 75.000₺ now uses token emerald matching the Available-limit KPI and sidebar green; widget title, metric values and dots all share the same token shades (cyan, purple, amber, rose), removing the earlier shade mismatch. Layout, spacing, typography, badges and KPI geometry unchanged; no clipping, truncation or contrast regressions. Residual issue from the earlier vision review is resolved; G-001/G-003 satisfied.

BEFORE at be1c6ca: the 7 KPI cards in an auto-fit 6-column grid leave a 6+1 layout; the seventh 'En Yakın Ödeme' card occupies only ~175px of a ~1120px row, leaving a large empty void. This pushes the cashflow widget down and keeps the analytics chart cards below the fold. Text, spacing and contrast are otherwise clean; this dead space is the targeted issue.

AFTER at e3e5721: the seventh KPI is now a full-width horizontal strip (label+icon left, value center, meta right, rose accent line across) with no dead space. Cashflow widget shifts up and both analytics chart cards now appear in the 1440x900 viewport - better information density and scannability. No clipping, truncation or contrast regressions; typography and card geometry intact. Desktop-only media query leaves the <=1300px and 2-column mobile grids unchanged.
